misconception_description: Student believes that variable identifiers can only be one letter long.

solutions.generated_code:
program SaringKataPanjang
kamus
  n, m, i, p : integer
  k : string
algoritma
  input(n, m)
  for i <- 1 to m do
    input(k)
    p <- panjang(k)
    if p > n then
      output(k)
    endif
  endfor
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student believes all variable identifiers can only be one letter long, so they've renamed: `long_words` → `l`, `str` → `s`, `word_len` → `w`, and `txt` → `t`. The variable `x` and parameter `n` remain unchanged as they were already single letters. The code functions identically to the original but with reduced readability due to non-descriptive single-letter identifiers throughout.
